-- Hoạt ảnh + vũ khí cho pet đứng (PetStanding.luau). ModuleScript độc lập, chưa gắn vào Training.server.luau.
-- Mọi góc dùng cùng công thức như bản xem mẫu trên web: tay xoay quanh trục X, góc dương = vung ra phía trước.
-- Dùng:
--   local model, rig = PetStanding.build(workspace)
--   local anim = PetAnimator.new(model, rig, game.ServerStorage.TrainingWeapons)
--   anim:SetWeapon("Hammer"); anim.OnHit = function(i) ... end
--   RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) anim:Update(dt) end)
--   anim:SetMoving(true); anim:Attack()
local Animator = {}
Animator.__index = Animator

-- k = tỉ lệ thu nhỏ; o = dịch vũ khí dọc cán để tay nắm ở chỗ hợp lý; R/L = mô hình lấy từ TrainingWeapons.
-- leftPose = tư thế tay trái khi cầm đồ; style = kiểu đòn đánh.
local WEAPONS = {
	Hammer = { k = 0.7, o = 0.9, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
	SwordShield = { k = 0.8, o = 0, R = "Main", L = "Offhand", style = "Overhead", leftPose = { 0.8, 0.5 } },
	Katana = { k = 0.75, o = 0.3, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
	Glaive = { k = 0.55, o = 1.6, R = "Main", style = "Thrust" },
	DualDaggers = { k = 0.9, o = 0, R = "Main", L = "Offhand", style = "Dual", leftPose = { 0.8, 0.5 } },
	Bow = { k = 0.7, o = 0, ry = math.pi / 2, L = "Main", style = "Shoot", leftPose = { 1.1, 0.5 } },
	GreatAxe = { k = 0.7, o = 0.8, R = "Main", style = "Overhead" },
}

-- Bộ số {u vai, l khuỷu, tilt vũ khí, lean thân}. t1 = hết giai đoạn gồng, t2 = hết giai đoạn đánh.
-- marks = các mốc tiến độ (0..1) gọi OnHit.
local STYLES = {
	Overhead = { dur = 0.8, t1 = 0.35, t2 = 0.6, wind = { 2.6, 0.3, -0.5, -0.15 }, hit = { 0.6, 0.9, 1.8, 0.3 }, marks = { 0.45 } },
	Thrust = { dur = 0.65, t1 = 0.3, t2 = 0.5, wind = { 0.5, 1.0, 0.7, -0.12 }, hit = { 1.4, 0.2, 1.5, 0.25 }, marks = { 0.4 } },
	Shoot = { dur = 1.0, t1 = 0.6, t2 = 0.72, wind = { 1.2, 1.7, 0, -0.05 }, hit = { 1.1, 0.5, 0, 0.06 }, marks = { 0.65 } },
	Dual = {
		dur = 0.9, t1 = 0.35, t2 = 0.6, dual = true, marks = { 0.25, 0.65 },
		wind = { 2.0, 0.5, -0.3, -0.1 }, hit = { 0.7, 0.8, 1.5, 0.2 },
	},
}

local function ease(x: number): number
	return x * x * (3 - 2 * x)
end
local function lerpT(a, b, s: number)
	return { a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * s, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * s, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * s, a[4] + (b[4] - a[4]) * s }
end
-- rest -> wind -> hit -> rest
local function blend(rest, wind, hit, p: number, t1: number, t2: number)
	if p < t1 then
		return lerpT(rest, wind, ease(p / t1))
	elseif p < t2 then
		return lerpT(wind, hit, ease((p - t1) / (t2 - t1)))
	end
	return lerpT(hit, rest, ease((p - t2) / (1 - t2)))
end

local function attachWeapon(pet: Model, grip: BasePart, source: Model, cfg, name: string)
	assert(source and source:IsA("Model") and source.PrimaryPart, "Weapon template needs a PrimaryPart")
	local clone = source:Clone()
	clone.Name = name
	clone:ScaleTo(cfg.k)
	local handle = clone.PrimaryPart
	for _, d in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored = false
			d.CanCollide = false
			d.CanQuery = false
			d.CanTouch = false
			d.Massless = true
		end
	end
	for _, d in clone:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") and d ~= handle then
			local w = Instance.new("Weld")
			w.Part0 = handle
			w.Part1 = d
			w.C0 = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(d.CFrame)
			w.Parent = d
		end
	end
	clone:PivotTo(grip.CFrame)
	local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
	motor.Name = name
	motor.Part0 = grip
	motor.Part1 = handle
	-- Keep the joint inside the clone so changing weapons destroys it too.
	motor.Parent = clone
	clone.Parent = pet
	return clone, motor
end

function Animator.new(model: Model, rig, templates: Instance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Animator)
	self.Model, self.Rig, self.Templates = model, rig, templates
	self.t = 0
	self.walkBlend = 0
	self.moving = false
	self.speed = 1
	self.atk = nil
	self.fired = {}
	self.OnHit = nil -- function(markIndex: number)
	self.weaponModels = {}
	self.RenderPose = true
	self.destroyed = false
	return self
end

function Animator:GetHitCount(): number
	return if self.cfg then #STYLES[self.cfg.style].marks else 0
end

function Animator:CancelAttack()
	self.atk = nil
	self.fired = {}
end

-- Client binds the server-created weapons; it never clones another copy.
function Animator:BindWeapon(id: string): boolean
	local cfg = WEAPONS[id]
	if not cfg then return false end
	local right = self.Model:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
	local left = self.Model:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")
	local motorR = right and right:FindFirstChild("WeaponR")
	local motorL = left and left:FindFirstChild("WeaponL")
	if cfg.R and (not motorR or not motorR:IsA("Motor6D")) then return false end
	if cfg.L and (not motorL or not motorL:IsA("Motor6D")) then return false end
	self.id, self.cfg = id, cfg
	self.motorR, self.motorL = motorR, motorL
	self:CancelAttack()
	return true
end

function Animator:SyncAttack(elapsed: number)
	if self.cfg then
		self.atk = self.t - math.max(0, elapsed)
		self.fired = {}
	end
end

function Animator:SetWeapon(id: string?)
	local cfg = if id then WEAPONS[id] else nil
	local template = if id then self.Templates:FindFirstChild(id) else nil
	assert(not id or (cfg and template), "Không có vũ khí: " .. tostring(id))
	for _, m in self.weaponModels do
		m:Destroy()
	end
	self.weaponModels, self.motorR, self.motorL, self.id, self.cfg = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
	self.atk = nil
	if not id then
		return
	end
	self.id, self.cfg = id, cfg
	if cfg.R then
		local m, motor = attachWeapon(self.Model, self.Rig.Grips.R, template[cfg.R], cfg, "WeaponR")
		table.insert(self.weaponModels, m)
		self.motorR = motor
	end
	if cfg.L then
		local m, motor = attachWeapon(self.Model, self.Rig.Grips.L, template[cfg.L], cfg, "WeaponL")
		table.insert(self.weaponModels, m)
		self.motorL = motor
	end
end

function Animator:SetMoving(on: boolean, speed: number?)
	self.moving = on
	self.speed = speed or 1
end

-- Bắt đầu đòn đánh. Trả về thời lượng (giây), hoặc nil nếu đang đánh hoặc chưa có vũ khí.
function Animator:Attack(): number?
	if self.destroyed or self.atk or not self.cfg then
		return nil
	end
	self.atk = self.t
	self.fired = {}
	return STYLES[self.cfg.style].dur
end

function Animator:IsAttacking(): boolean
	return self.atk ~= nil
end

function Animator:Update(dt: number)
	if self.destroyed then return end
	self.t += dt
	local t = self.t
	local cfg = self.cfg
	local m = self.Rig.Motors

	self.walkBlend += ((if self.moving then 1 else 0) - self.walkBlend) * (1 - math.exp(-10 * dt))
	local sw = math.sin(t * 6 * self.speed) * self.walkBlend

	-- Tư thế nghỉ của hai tay: {u, l, tilt, lean}
	local restR = if cfg and cfg.R then { 0.7, 0.8, 0.25, 0 } else { 0.15, 0.25, 0.25, 0 }
	local restL = if cfg and cfg.leftPose then { cfg.leftPose[1], cfg.leftPose[2], 0, 0 } else { 0.15, 0.25, 0, 0 }
	local R, L = restR, restL

	if self.atk and cfg then
		local style = STYLES[cfg.style]
		local p = (t - self.atk) / style.dur
		-- Process crossed marks even when this frame reaches/passes recovery.
		for i, mark in style.marks do
			if p >= mark and not self.fired[i] then
				self.fired[i] = true
				if self.OnHit then self.OnHit(i) end
			end
		end
		if self.destroyed then return end
		if p >= 1 then
			self.atk = nil
		else
			if style.dual then
				R = blend(restR, style.wind, style.hit, math.clamp(p / 0.55, 0, 1), style.t1, style.t2)
				L = blend(restL, style.wind, style.hit, math.clamp((p - 0.35) / 0.65, 0, 1), style.t1, style.t2)
				R = { R[1], R[2], R[3], (R[4] + L[4]) / 2 }
			else
				R = blend(restR, style.wind, style.hit, p, style.t1, style.t2)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Server advances hit timing; clients apply the visual pose in PreSimulation.
	if not self.RenderPose then return end
	local uR, lR, uL, lL = R[1], R[2], L[1], L[2]
	if not self.atk then
		uR -= sw * 0.12
		uL += sw * 0.12
	end

	m.Torso.Transform = CFrame.new(0, (if self.moving then math.abs(sw) * 0.1 else math.sin(t * 2) * 0.025), 0)
		* CFrame.Angles(R[4], 0, 0)
	m.ArmR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(uR, 0, 0)
	m.ForeR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(lR, 0, 0)
	m.ArmL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(uL, 0, 0)
	m.ForeL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(lL, 0, 0)
	m.LegR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(sw * 0.6, 0, 0)
	m.LegL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-sw * 0.6, 0, 0)
	m.Head.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.sin(t * 3) * 0.04, if self.atk then 0 else math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.25, 0)
	m.Tail1.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 3) * 0.18, 0)
	m.Tail2.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, math.sin(t * 3 - 0.9) * 0.28, 0)

	-- Vũ khí luôn bù góc để giữ hướng: xoay X (bù tay + tilt), rồi dịch dọc cán, rồi xoay Y.
	if cfg then
		local shift = CFrame.new(0, cfg.o * cfg.k, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, cfg.ry or 0, 0)
		if self.motorR then
			self.motorR.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-(uR + lR) - R[3], 0, 0) * shift
		end
		if self.motorL then
			self.motorL.Transform = CFrame.Angles(-(uL + lL) - L[3], 0, 0) * shift
		end
	end
end

function Animator:Destroy()
	if self.destroyed then return end
	self.destroyed = true
	self:CancelAttack()
	self.OnHit = nil
	for _, w in self.weaponModels do
		w:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(self.weaponModels)
	self.motorR, self.motorL, self.cfg = nil, nil, nil
end

return Animator

local Rules={}
local keys={Light="L",Heavy="H",Skill="S"}
function Rules.staminaCost(config,base) return base*config.StaminaCostScale end
function Rules.clearCombo(state)
 state.ComboChain=""; state.ComboStep=0; state.ComboUntil=0
end
function Rules.dodge(config,weapons,state,now)
 local cost=Rules.staminaCost(config,config.DodgeCost)
 if state.Blocking or now<state.BusyUntil or state.Stamina+1e-7<cost then return false end
 local chain=if now<=state.ComboUntil then state.ComboChain or "" else ""
 local nextChain=chain.."D"
 for _,combo in weapons[state.WeaponId].Combos do
  if #nextChain<#combo.Input and combo.Input:sub(1,#nextChain)==nextChain then chain=nextChain; break end
 end
 state.Stamina=math.max(0,state.Stamina-cost); state.BusyUntil=now+config.DodgeTime
 state.DodgingUntil=state.BusyUntil; state.LastSpend=state.BusyUntil; state.Sprinting=false
 state.ComboChain=chain; state.ComboStep=#chain; state.ComboUntil=state.BusyUntil+config.ComboWindow
 return true
end
function Rules.attack(config,weapons,state,action,now)
 if not keys[action] then return nil end
 if not state.Drawn or now<state.BusyUntil or state.Sprinting or state.Blocking then return nil end
 local weapon=weapons[state.WeaponId]; if not weapon or not weapon.Attacks then return nil end
 local chain=(if now<=state.ComboUntil then state.ComboChain or "" else "")..keys[action]
 local kind=action
 for _,combo in weapon.Combos do
  if chain==combo.Input then kind=combo.Attack; break end
 end
 local spec=weapon.Attacks[kind]; local cost=Rules.staminaCost(config,spec.Cost)
 if state.Stamina+1e-7<cost then return nil end
 state.Stamina=math.max(0,state.Stamina-cost); state.BusyUntil=now+spec.Duration; state.LastSpend=state.BusyUntil
 -- Keep the longest suffix that starts a recipe; rejected inputs never advance it.
 local prefix=""
 if kind==action then
  for start=1,#chain do
   local suffix=chain:sub(start)
   for _,combo in weapon.Combos do
    if #suffix<#combo.Input and combo.Input:sub(1,#suffix)==suffix and #suffix>#prefix then prefix=suffix end
   end
  end
 end
 state.ComboChain=prefix; state.ComboStep=#prefix; state.ComboUntil=state.BusyUntil+config.ComboWindow
 return kind,spec
end
function Rules.canEquip(state,weapons,id,now)
 return typeof(id)=="string" and weapons[id]~=nil and id~="Order" and state.InTraining
  and not state.Drawn and not state.Blocking and not state.Sprinting and now>=state.BusyUntil
end
function Rules.regenerate(config,state,now,dt)
 if not state.Sprinting and not state.Blocking and now>=state.BusyUntil and now-state.LastSpend>=config.RegenDelay then
  state.Stamina=math.min(config.MaxStamina,state.Stamina+config.StaminaRegen*dt)
 end
end
return Rules

-- L0: sảnh + bãi tập; không có thưởng, DataStore hay nhiệm vụ săn.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.TrainingConfig)
local Rules = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.TrainingRules)
local Weapons = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Weapons)
local weaponTemplates = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):WaitForChild("TrainingWeapons")
local PetStanding = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared:WaitForChild("PetStanding"))
local PetAnimator = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared:WaitForChild("PetAnimator"))
local PetPlacement = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared:WaitForChild("PetPlacement"))
local map = workspace:WaitForChild("HunDinoL0")
local dummies = map.Training.Dummies
local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
remote.Name = "HunDinoTrainingAction"; remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
local states, owners = {}, {}
local pets = Instance.new("Folder"); pets.Name = "TrainingPets"; pets.Parent = workspace

local function makePart(parent, name, size, color, cf, anchored)
	local p = Instance.new("Part"); p.Name = name; p.Size = size; p.Color = color
	p.CFrame = cf; p.Anchored = anchored or false; p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false; p.Massless = true; p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Parent = parent; return p
end
local function weld(a, b, offset)
	b.CFrame = a.CFrame * offset
	local w = Instance.new("Weld"); w.Part0 = a; w.Part1 = b; w.C0 = offset; w.Parent = b
	return w
end
local function alive(s)
	return s and s.Character and s.Character.Parent and s.Humanoid.Health > 0 and s.Root.Parent
end
local function grounded(s)
	return not s.Humanoid.Sit and not s.Root.Anchored
		and s.Humanoid.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air
end
local function sync(s)
	local p = s.Player
	p:SetAttribute("Stamina", math.floor(s.Stamina + 0.5))
	p:SetAttribute("Drawn", s.Drawn)
	p:SetAttribute("WeaponId", s.WeaponId)
	p:SetAttribute("Blocking", s.Blocking)
	p:SetAttribute("BowBoost", s.BowBoostUntil > os.clock())
	p:SetAttribute("TrainingDamage", s.Damage)
	p:SetAttribute("PetDamage", s.PetDamage)
	p:SetAttribute("ComboStep", if os.clock() <= s.ComboUntil then s.ComboStep else 0)
	p:SetAttribute("ComboChain", if os.clock() <= s.ComboUntil then s.ComboChain or "" else "")
end
local function message(s, text)
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Message", text)
end
local function equipArmor(s, enabled)
	if s.Armor then s.Armor:Destroy(); s.Armor = nil end
	s.Player:SetAttribute("TrainingArmor", enabled)
	if not enabled then return end
	local torso = s.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	if not torso then return end
	local armor = Instance.new("Model"); armor.Name = "TrainingArmor"; armor.Parent = s.Character; s.Armor = armor
	local chest = makePart(armor, "LeatherPlate", Vector3.new(2.15, 1.7, 0.4), Color3.fromRGB(92, 71, 48), torso.CFrame)
	weld(torso, chest, CFrame.new(0, 0, -0.62))
	local badge = makePart(armor, "HunterBadge", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.6, 0.12), Color3.fromRGB(232, 183, 95), torso.CFrame)
	weld(torso, badge, CFrame.new(0, 0.25, -0.88))
	for _, side in {-1, 1} do
		local limb = s.Character:FindFirstChild(if side == -1 then "LeftUpperArm" else "RightUpperArm")
			or s.Character:FindFirstChild(if side == -1 then "Left Arm" else "Right Arm")
		if limb then
			local p = makePart(armor, "Shoulder", Vector3.new(1.1, 0.5, 1.1), Color3.fromRGB(68, 106, 98), limb.CFrame)
			weld(limb, p, CFrame.new(0, 0.5, 0))
		end
	end
end
local function weaponPose(s)
	if not s.Grip or not s.Grip.Parent then return end
	local torso = s.Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso") or s.Root
	local left = s.Character:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or torso
	local right = s.Character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or s.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or torso
	if s.Drawn then
		s.Grip.Part0 = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then left else right
		s.RestPose = if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then CFrame.new(0, .1, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(0, -math.pi/2, 0)
			else CFrame.new(0, -.5, -.5) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-25), 0, math.rad(10))
	else
		s.Grip.Part0 = torso
		s.RestPose = CFrame.new(.5, -1, 1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-30))
	end
	s.Grip.C0 = s.RestPose
	if s.OffGrip then
		s.OffGrip.Part0 = if s.Drawn then left else torso
		s.OffRest = if s.Drawn then CFrame.new(0, -.3, -.35) else CFrame.new(-.7, -.7, 1.3)
		s.OffGrip.C0 = if s.Blocking then CFrame.new(.5,.5,-1) * CFrame.Angles(0,-.3,0) else s.OffRest
	end
	if s.SheathGrip then s.SheathGrip.Part0 = torso; s.SheathGrip.C0 = CFrame.new(.5,-1,1.04)*CFrame.Angles(0,0,math.rad(-30)) end
end

local function createWeapon(s)
	if s.WeaponModel then s.WeaponModel:Destroy() end
	s.OffGrip = nil; s.SheathGrip = nil
	local model = weaponTemplates[s.WeaponId]:Clone(); model.Name = "TrainingWeapon"
	for _, assembly in model:GetChildren() do
		local handle = assembly.PrimaryPart
		for _, p in assembly:GetChildren() do
			if p:IsA("BasePart") then
				p.Anchored = false; p.CanCollide = false; p.CanQuery = false; p.Massless = true
				if p ~= handle then weld(handle,p,handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)) end
			end
		end
		local grip = weld(s.Root,handle,CFrame.new())
		if assembly.Name == "Main" then s.Grip = grip elseif assembly.Name == "Offhand" then s.OffGrip = grip else s.SheathGrip = grip end
	end
	model.Parent = s.Character; s.WeaponModel = model; weaponPose(s)
end
local function equipWeapon(s,id)
	if not Rules.canEquip(s,Weapons,id,os.clock()) then
		message(s,"Cất vũ khí bằng R và dừng động tác trước khi đổi trong bãi tập."); return
	end
	s.WeaponId=id; Rules.clearCombo(s); s.LastTarget=nil; s.BowBoostUntil=0; s.Aiming=false
	s.BusyUntil=os.clock()+.3; s.WantSprint=false
	createWeapon(s)
	if s.PetAnimator then
		s.PetAnimator:SetWeapon(id); s.PetTarget = nil
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetWeaponId", id)
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", -1)
	end
	sync(s); message(s,"Đã chọn "..Weapons[id].Name..". Nhấn R để rút.")
end
local function destroyPet(s)
	if s.PetAnimator then s.PetAnimator:Destroy(); s.PetAnimator = nil end
	if s.Pet then s.Pet:Destroy(); s.Pet = nil end
	s.PetTarget = nil
end
local function createPet(s)
	local pet, rig = PetStanding.build()
	pet.Name = "Pet_" .. s.Player.UserId
	pet.ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Atomic
	local animator = PetAnimator.new(pet, rig, weaponTemplates)
	animator.RenderPose = false
	animator:SetWeapon(s.WeaponId)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetWeaponId", s.WeaponId)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetMoving", false)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetSpeed", 1)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", 0)
	pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", -1)
	PetPlacement.place(pet, s.Character, s.Root.CFrame, pets)
	pet.Parent = pets
	s.Pet, s.PetAnimator, s.PetClock = pet, animator, 0
end
local function updateDummy(dummy)
	local gui = dummy.Target.SignGui.Text
	gui.Text = (dummy:GetAttribute("Label") or "HÌNH NỘM " .. dummy.Name:match("%d+")) .. "\n" .. dummy:GetAttribute("Health") .. " / " .. Config.DummyHealth
end
local function hit(s, dummy, damage, isPet)
	if not dummy:IsDescendantOf(dummies) then return end
	local hp = dummy:GetAttribute("Health")
	local applied = math.min(hp, damage)
	hp -= applied
	if isPet then s.PetDamage += applied else s.Damage += applied end
	-- Đây là hình nộm vô hạn, làm đầy lại khi bị hạ; không phát thưởng.
	dummy:SetAttribute("Health", if hp <= 0 then Config.DummyHealth else hp)
	updateDummy(dummy)
	remote:FireAllClients("Hit", dummy.Target.Position, applied, isPet)
	sync(s)
end
local function directionOK(v, ranged)
	return typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.X == v.X and v.Y == v.Y and v.Z == v.Z
		and math.abs(v.X) < 2 and math.abs(v.Z) < 2 and math.abs(v.Y) < (if ranged then 2 else .01) and v.Magnitude > 0.5
end
local function lineOfSight(s, pos, dummy)
	local params = RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
	local result = workspace:Raycast(s.Root.Position, pos - s.Root.Position, params)
	return not result or result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy)
end
local function startPetAttack(s, target)
	local animator = s.PetAnimator
	if not animator or animator:IsAttacking() then return end
	s.PetTarget = target
	local count = animator:GetHitCount()
	animator.OnHit = function(index)
		if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or not s.InTraining or s.PetTarget ~= target
			or s.LastTarget ~= target or not target:IsDescendantOf(dummies)
			or os.clock() >= (s.TargetUntil or 0) then return end
		local point = target.Target.Position
		local center = s.Pet.PrimaryPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {s.Character, pets}
		local obstruction = workspace:Raycast(center, point - center, params)
		if (center - point).Magnitude > 7 or (s.Root.Position - point).Magnitude >= 18
			or (obstruction and not obstruction.Instance:IsDescendantOf(target)) then return end
		-- Split the original total damage across the two dagger strikes.
		local amount = math.floor(Config.PetDamage / count)
			+ (if index <= Config.PetDamage % count then 1 else 0)
		hit(s, target, amount, true)
		if s.WeaponId == "Bow" then remote:FireAllClients("Shot", center, point, false) end
	end
	if animator:Attack() then
		s.PetClock = os.clock() + Config.PetInterval
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
		s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackSequence", s.Pet:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") + 1)
	end
end
local function attack(s, action, direction)
	local weapon=Weapons[s.WeaponId]
	if not s.InTraining or not directionOK(direction,weapon.Ranged) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local kind, spec = Rules.attack(Config, Weapons, s, action, now)
	if not kind then return end
	direction = direction.Unit
	local flat=Vector3.new(direction.X,0,direction.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude>.01 then s.Root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(s.Root.Position, s.Root.Position + flat) end
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = false
	local character = s.Character
	local boosted=weapon.Ranged and now<s.BowBoostUntil
	if weapon.Ranged then s.BowBoostUntil=0 end
	remote:FireClient(s.Player, "Attack", kind, spec.Name, spec.Duration)
	-- A serial prevents a late recovery callback from overwriting the next strike.
	s.AttackSerial=(s.AttackSerial or 0)+1; local serial=s.AttackSerial
	local windup = s.RestPose * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(100), 0, math.rad(-30))
	if spec.Style=="Thrust" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.7)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
	elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,-1.4,math.pi/2) end
	if weapon.Ranged then windup=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,.25) end
	TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(spec.Windup), {C0 = windup}):Play()
	task.delay(spec.Windup, function()
		if not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		if weapon.Ranged then
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip,TweenInfo.new(.16),{C0=s.RestPose}):Play()
			local params=RaycastParams.new(); params.FilterType=Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances={s.Character,pets}
			for i=1,spec.Shots or 1 do
				if i>1 and spec.ShotInterval then task.wait(spec.ShotInterval) end
				if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
				local origin=s.Root.Position+Vector3.new(0,.8,0)
				local angle=math.rad(math.ceil((i-1)/2)*(if i%2==0 then -1 else 1)*(spec.Spread or 4))
				local aim=CFrame.fromAxisAngle(Vector3.yAxis,angle):VectorToWorldSpace(direction)
				local result=workspace:Raycast(origin,aim*spec.Range,params)
				local endpoint=if result then result.Position else origin+aim*spec.Range
				remote:FireAllClients("Shot",origin,endpoint,boosted and i==1)
				if result then
					for _,dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do if result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(dummy) then
						hit(s,dummy,math.floor(spec.Damage*(if boosted and i==1 then 1.25 else 1)+.5),false); s.LastTarget=dummy; s.TargetUntil=os.clock()+12
						break
					end end
				end
			end
			return
		end
		for n=1,spec.Hits or 1 do
			if n>1 then task.wait(spec.HitInterval or .13) end
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character or states[s.Player]~=s or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
			local pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-95),0,if n%2==0 then -.4 else .4)
			if spec.Style=="Thrust" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.new(0,0,-2)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)
			elseif spec.Style=="Spin" or spec.Style=="Sweep" then pose=s.RestPose*CFrame.Angles(0,if n%2==0 then -1.5 else 1.5,math.pi/2) end
			TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(.1), {C0=pose}):Play()
			if spec.Style=="Shield" and s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.new(.4,.3,-1.2)}):Play() end
			if spec.Name then remote:FireAllClients("ComboFX",s.Root.CFrame,spec.Style,spec.Range) end
			if s.OffGrip and s.WeaponId=="DualDaggers" then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.1),{C0=s.OffRest*CFrame.Angles(-1.5,0,if n%2==0 then .4 else -.4)}):Play() end
			for _, dummy in dummies:GetChildren() do
				local delta = dummy.Target.Position - s.Root.Position
				local targetFlat = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z)
				if delta.Magnitude <= spec.Range and targetFlat.Magnitude > 0 and direction:Dot(targetFlat.Unit) >= (spec.Arc or .3)
					and lineOfSight(s, dummy.Target.Position, dummy) then
					hit(s, dummy, spec.Damage, false); s.LastTarget = dummy; s.TargetUntil = now + 12
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	task.delay(spec.Duration, function()
		if states[s.Player] ~= s or not alive(s) or s.Character ~= character or s.AttackSerial~=serial then return end
		TweenService:Create(s.Grip, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {C0 = s.RestPose}):Play()
		if s.OffGrip then TweenService:Create(s.OffGrip,TweenInfo.new(.12),{C0=s.OffRest}):Play() end
		s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
	end)
	sync(s)
end
local function toggleDraw(s, target)
	if os.clock() < s.BusyUntil then return end
	s.BusyUntil = os.clock() + Config.SheatheTime; Rules.clearCombo(s); s.Sprinting = false
	s.Blocking=false; s.BowBoostUntil=0; s.Aiming=false; weaponPose(s)
	s.ChangeDraw = target
	message(s, (if target then "Đang rút " else "Đang cất ")..Weapons[s.WeaponId].Name.."…")
end
local function travel(s, destination)
	if s.Travelling then return end
	if os.clock() < s.BusyUntil then return end
	s.InTraining = destination == "Training"; s.Drawn = false; s.WantSprint = false; s.Sprinting = false
	s.ChangeDraw = nil; Rules.clearCombo(s); s.LastTarget = nil; s.BusyUntil = os.clock() + 0.5
	s.Blocking=false; s.Aiming=false; s.BowBoostUntil=0
	s.Humanoid.AutoRotate = true; weaponPose(s)
	local cf = if s.InTraining then map.Training.Arrival.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
		else map.Lobby.Arrival.CFrame
	s.Travelling = true
 local before = s.Character
 s.BusyUntil = math.huge
 pcall(function() s.Player:RequestStreamAroundAsync(cf.Position, 3) end)
 s.Travelling = false
 if not alive(s) or states[s.Player] ~= s or s.Character ~= before then return end
 s.BusyUntil = os.clock() + 0.5
 s.Character:PivotTo(cf); s.Root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	s.PetAnimator:CancelAttack(); s.PetTarget = nil
	s.Pet:SetAttribute("PetAttackStarted", -1)
	PetPlacement.place(s.Pet, s.Character, cf, pets)
	s.Player:SetAttribute("InTraining", s.InTraining)
	message(s, if s.InTraining then "Nhấn I chọn vũ khí, R để rút. Cận chiến bên trái, cung bên phải." else "Đã trở về trại thợ săn.")
	sync(s)
end
local function bindPrompt(part, callback)
	local prompt = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local s = states[player]
		-- Prompt vẫn phải được xác minh trên server.
		if not alive(s) or (s.Root.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > 12 or os.clock() < s.BusyUntil then return end
		callback(s)
	end)
end
bindPrompt(map.Lobby.ToTraining, function(s) travel(s, "Training") end)
bindPrompt(map.Training.ToLobby, function(s) travel(s, "Lobby") end)
bindPrompt(map.Training.EquipmentRack, function(s)
	if s.Drawn then message(s, "Cất vũ khí bằng R trước khi thay giáp."); return end
	equipArmor(s, not s.Player:GetAttribute("TrainingArmor")); s.BusyUntil = os.clock() + 0.3
end)
bindPrompt(map.Training.ResetPost, function(s)
	if s.Drawn then message(s, "Cất vũ khí bằng R trước khi tương tác."); return end
	s.Damage = 0; s.PetDamage = 0; s.Stamina = Config.MaxStamina; Rules.clearCombo(s); s.LastTarget = nil
	s.Humanoid.Health = s.Humanoid.MaxHealth; s.BusyUntil = os.clock() + 0.3; sync(s)
	message(s, "Đã xóa thống kê của bạn. Bắt đầu lượt tập mới!")
end)
for _,rack in map.Training.WeaponRacks:GetChildren() do
	bindPrompt(rack,function(s) equipWeapon(s,rack.Name) end)
end
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, value)
	local s = states[player]
	if not alive(s) or typeof(action) ~= "string" then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	-- Giới hạn cả request không hợp lệ trước khi xử lý trạng thái.
	if now - s.PacketWindow >= 1 then s.PacketWindow = now; s.Packets = 0 end
	s.Packets += 1; if s.Packets > 30 then return end
	if action == "EquipWeapon" then
		equipWeapon(s,value)
	elseif action == "TravelMenu" then
		if value~="Training" and value~="Lobby" then return end
		if s.Drawn or s.Blocking or now<s.BusyUntil or s.Sprinting then
			message(s,"Cất vũ khí và dừng động tác trước khi chuyển khu."); return
		end
		travel(s,value)
	elseif action == "Aim" then
		s.Aiming=value==true and s.WeaponId=="Bow" and s.Drawn
	elseif action == "Guard" then
		if value==false then s.Blocking=false; weaponPose(s)
		elseif value==true and s.WeaponId=="SwordShield" and s.Drawn and now>=s.BusyUntil and s.Stamina>0 then
			s.Blocking=true; s.Sprinting=false; s.WantSprint=false; Rules.clearCombo(s); weaponPose(s)
		end
		sync(s)
	elseif action == "Sprint" then
		if typeof(value) ~= "boolean" then return end
		s.WantSprint = value; if value then Rules.clearCombo(s); s.Blocking=false; weaponPose(s) end
		if not value then s.Sprinting = false end
	elseif action == "Draw" then
		s.WantSprint = false; toggleDraw(s, not s.Drawn)
	elseif action == "Light" or action == "Heavy" or action == "Skill" then
		attack(s, action, value)
	elseif action == "Jump" and not s.Blocking and now >= s.BusyUntil and grounded(s) and now - s.LastJumpAt >= 0.45 then
		Rules.clearCombo(s); s.LastJumpAt = now; s.BusyUntil = now + 0.15
		remote:FireClient(player, "Jump", s.Character)
	elseif action == "Dodge" and not s.Blocking and directionOK(value) and now >= s.BusyUntil and grounded(s)
		and now - s.LastJumpAt >= 0.45 and Rules.dodge(Config,Weapons,s,now) then
		remote:FireClient(player,"Dodge",Config.DodgeTime)
		s.Humanoid.WalkSpeed=Config.WalkSpeed
		if s.WeaponId=="Bow" and s.Drawn and s.Aiming then s.BowBoostUntil=now+4 end
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment"); a.Name = "DodgeAttachment"; a.Parent = s.Root
		local velocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity"); velocity.Name = "DodgeVelocity"; velocity.Attachment0 = a
		velocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World; velocity.MaxForce = 100000
		-- Constrain only the ground plane; gravity must remain free on slopes/edges.
		velocity.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
		velocity.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.xAxis; velocity.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.zAxis
		local direction = value.Unit
		velocity.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(direction.X, direction.Z) * Config.DodgeSpeed
		velocity.Parent = s.Root
		-- Ease toward walking speed instead of an abrupt full-speed stop.
		TweenService:Create(velocity,TweenInfo.new(Config.DodgeTime,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{PlaneVelocity=Vector2.new(direction.X,direction.Z)*Config.WalkSpeed}):Play()
		local root=s.Root; local character=s.Character
		task.delay(Config.DodgeTime, function()
			velocity:Destroy(); a:Destroy()
			if not alive(s) or s.Character~=character then return end
			local move=s.Humanoid.MoveDirection
			local residual=if move.Magnitude>.1 then move*Config.WalkSpeed else direction*4
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.new(residual.X,root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y,residual.Z)
		end)
		sync(s)
	end

-- Feet follow the collision surface rather than the old body's height offset.
local Placement = {}

function Placement.position(character: Model, point: Vector3, pets: Instance?): Vector3
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = if pets then { character, pets } else { character }
	params.RespectCanCollide = true
	local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local height = if root then root.Position.Y else point.Y
	local result = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(point.X, height + 6, point.Z), Vector3.new(0, -128, 0), params)
	local fallback = height - (if hum then hum.HipHeight else 2) - (if root then root.Size.Y / 2 else 1)
	return Vector3.new(point.X, (if result then result.Position.Y else fallback) + 0.03, point.Z)
end

function Placement.place(pet: Model, character: Model, cf: CFrame, pets: Instance?)
	local goal = Placement.position(character, cf:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(3, 0, 3)), pets)
	pet:PivotTo(CFrame.new(goal) * cf.Rotation)
end

return Placement

local function basePart(name, size, color)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = color
	p.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Anchored = false
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.CanTouch = false
	p.CanQuery = false
	p.Massless = true
	return p
end

-- Trả về (model, rig). rig.Motors[tên khớp] để sau này đặt Transform làm hoạt ảnh.
function PetStanding.build(parent: Instance?)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "PetStanding"

	local bones: { [string]: BasePart } = {}
	local worlds: { [string]: CFrame } = {}
	local motors: { [string]: Motor6D } = {}

	-- Root: khớp gốc cố định, neo; mọi khối khác nối vào nó nên PivotTo cả mô hình vẫn đúng.
	local root = basePart("Root", Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), WHITE)
	root.Transparency = 1
	root.Anchored = true
	root.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	root.Parent = model
	model.PrimaryPart = root
	bones.Root, worlds.Root = root, CFrame.new()

	for _, def in BONES do
		local name, parentName, offset = def[1], def[2], def[3]
		local part = basePart(name, Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), WHITE)
		part.Transparency = 1
		local world = worlds[parentName] * CFrame.new(offset)
		part.CFrame = world
		part.Parent = model
		local motor = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		motor.Name = name
		motor.Part0 = bones[parentName]
		motor.Part1 = part
		motor.C0 = CFrame.new(offset)
		motor.C1 = CFrame.new()
		motor.Parent = bones[parentName]
		bones[name], worlds[name], motors[name] = part, world, motor
	end

	local slots: { [string]: { BasePart } } = { Helmet = {}, Armor = {}, Horns = {} }
	for i, def in PARTS do
		local bone, size, pos, color, rot, slot = def[1], def[2], def[3], def[4], def[5], def[6]
		local part = basePart(bone .. "_" .. i, size, color)
		local offset = CFrame.new(pos)
		if rot then
			offset = offset * CFrame.Angles(rot[1], rot[2], rot[3])
		end
		part.CFrame = worlds[bone] * offset
		local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
		weld.Part0 = bones[bone]
		weld.Part1 = part
		weld.C0 = offset
		weld.Parent = part
		part.Parent = model
		if slot then
			part:SetAttribute("Slot", slot)
			table.insert(slots[slot], part)
		end
	end

	local rig = { Motors = motors, Bones = bones, Slots = slots, Grips = { R = bones.GripR, L = bones.GripL } }
	PetStanding.setHelmet(rig, true)
	PetStanding.setArmor(rig, true)
	if parent then
		model.Parent = parent
	end
	return model, rig
end

-- Resolve the replicated rig without creating another pet on the client.
function PetStanding.bind(model: Model)
	local bones, motors = {}, {}
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then return nil end
	bones.Root = root
	for _, def in BONES do
		local bone = model:FindFirstChild(def[1])
		local parent = bones[def[2]]
		local motor = parent and parent:FindFirstChild(def[1])
		if not bone or not bone:IsA("BasePart") or not motor or not motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
			return nil
		end
		bones[def[1]], motors[def[1]] = bone, motor
	end
	local slots = { Helmet = {}, Armor = {}, Horns = {} }
	for _, part in model:GetChildren() do
		if part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local slot = part:GetAttribute("Slot")
			if slot and slots[slot] then table.insert(slots[slot], part) end
		end
	end
	return { Motors = motors, Bones = bones, Slots = slots, Grips = { R = bones.GripR, L = bones.GripL } }
end

-- Ẩn bằng Transparency để khớp nối không bị tháo ra.
local function show(parts: { BasePart }, on: boolean)
	for _, p in parts do
		p.Transparency = if on then 0 else 1
	end
end
-- Khi có mũ thì ẩn sừng tự nhiên của pet để khỏi xuyên qua mũ.
function PetStanding.setHelmet(rig, on: boolean)
	show(rig.Slots.Helmet, on)
	show(rig.Slots.Horns, not on)
end
function PetStanding.setArmor(rig, on: boolean)
	show(rig.Slots.Armor, on)
end

return PetStanding

-- Logic thuần: dùng chung với bài kiểm tra ngoài Studio.
local Rules = {}
function Rules.attack(config, state, action, now)
	if action ~= "Light" and action ~= "Heavy" and action ~= "Skill" then return nil end
	if not state.Drawn or now < state.BusyUntil or state.Sprinting then return nil end
	local step = if now <= state.ComboUntil then state.ComboStep else 0
	local kind = if action == "Skill" and step == 2 then "Finisher" else action
	local attack = config.Attacks[kind]
	if state.Stamina < attack.Cost then return nil end
	state.Stamina -= attack.Cost
	state.BusyUntil = now + attack.Duration
	state.LastSpend = state.BusyUntil
	state.ComboStep = if action == "Light" then 1 elseif action == "Heavy" and step == 1 then 2 else 0
	state.ComboUntil = state.BusyUntil + config.ComboWindow
	return kind, attack
end
function Rules.regenerate(config, state, now, dt)
	if not state.Sprinting and now >= state.BusyUntil and now - state.LastSpend >= config.RegenDelay then
		state.Stamina = math.min(config.MaxStamina, state.Stamina + config.StaminaRegen * dt)
	end
end
return Rules

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local PetStanding = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("PetStanding"))
local PetAnimator = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared:WaitForChild("PetAnimator"))
local pets = workspace:WaitForChild("TrainingPets")
local entries = {}

local function discard(model)
	local entry = entries[model]
	if entry then entry.anim:Destroy(); entries[model] = nil end
end

local connection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
	for model in entries do
		if model.Parent ~= pets or not model:FindFirstChild("Root") then discard(model) end
	end
	for _, model in pets:GetChildren() do
		if not model:IsA("Model") then continue end
		local entry = entries[model]
		if not entry then
			local rig = PetStanding.bind(model)
			if not rig then continue end
			entry = { anim = PetAnimator.new(model, rig, nil), sequence = -1, weapon = nil }
			entries[model] = entry
		end
		local anim = entry.anim
		local id = model:GetAttribute("PetWeaponId")
		if entry.weapon ~= id or (anim.motorR and not anim.motorR.Parent) or (anim.motorL and not anim.motorL.Parent) then
			if not id or not anim:BindWeapon(id) then continue end
			entry.weapon = id
			entry.sequence = -1
		end
		anim:SetMoving(model:GetAttribute("PetMoving") == true, model:GetAttribute("PetSpeed") or 1)
		local sequence = model:GetAttribute("PetAttackSequence") or 0
		local started = model:GetAttribute("PetAttackStarted") or -1
		if started < 0 then
			anim:CancelAttack()
		elseif sequence ~= entry.sequence then
			anim:SyncAttack(workspace:GetServerTimeNow() - started)
		end
		entry.sequence = sequence
		anim:Update(dt)
	end
end)

script.Destroying:Connect(function()
	connection:Disconnect()
	for model in entries do discard(model) end
end)
